headline: Account Executive
summary: Account executive with four years selling industrial equipment and parts to plantations, mines and factories in Caraga. I manage a territory of about 90 accounts, build proposals, negotiate annual supply agreements and keep every opportunity in Salesforce. I consistently finish above quota.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Manage about 90 accounts across Agusan and Surigao, reaching 118% of quota in 2025.
Negotiated a three-year parts supply agreement with a palm oil mill worth ₱28 million.
Study competitor pricing and plantation expansion plans to decide which accounts to prioritise each quarter.
Prepare technical proposals with the service engineers and present them to plant managers.

experience.title: Sales Representative
bullets: Sold generators, water pumps and power tools to contractors and walk-in customers.
Found new contractor accounts by visiting project sites each week.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing Management
